## Read in HLA

Check the consistency of HLA-I alleles from TCGA vs. those from a TCGA HLA benchmark study. The latter also have the data for HLA-II alleles.

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)

HLA = fread("~/research/data/TCR/TCGA/OptiTypeCallsHLA_20171207.tsv")
dim(HLA)
HLA[1:2,]

HLA$Sample_Barcode = substr(HLA$aliquot_id, 1, 12)
table(table(HLA$Sample_Barcode))

HLA$Sample_Type = substr(HLA$aliquot_id, 14, 15)
table(HLA$Sample_Type)

HLA1 <- HLA %>%
  group_by(Sample_Barcode) %>%
  slice_max(Objective, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

dim(HLA1)
table(table(HLA1$Sample_Barcode))
table(HLA1$Sample_Type)

fpath = "~/research/GitHub/_others/TCGA_HLA_benchmark/HLA_allele_data/"
HLA2 = read_excel(paste0(fpath, "TCGA_HLA_benchmark_20200810.xlsx"), 
                  sheet = "HLA_genotyping")
HLA2 = as.data.frame(HLA2)
dim(HLA2)
HLA2[1:2,]

length(unique(HLA2$Sample_Barcode))

table(HLA1$Sample_Barcode %in% HLA2$Sample_Barcode)
table(HLA2$Sample_Barcode %in% HLA1$Sample_Barcode)

# Join the tables on Sample_Barcode
df <- HLA1 %>%
  inner_join(HLA2, by = "Sample_Barcode")
dim(df)

hla_match <- df %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    same_A = setequal(sort(str_extract_all(HLA_ClassI, "A\\*\\d+:\\d+")[[1]]), 
                      sort(unique(c(A1, A2)))),
    same_B = setequal(sort(str_extract_all(HLA_ClassI, "B\\*\\d+:\\d+")[[1]]), 
                      sort(unique(c(B1, B2)))),
    same_C = setequal(sort(str_extract_all(HLA_ClassI, "C\\*\\d+:\\d+")[[1]]), 
                      sort(unique(c(C1, C2))))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Sample_Barcode, same_A, same_B, same_C)

dim(hla_match)
hla_match[1:2,]

table(hla_match$same_A)
table(hla_match$same_B)
table(hla_match$same_C)

```

## Get HLA data matrix

```{r}
hla_I_matrix <- HLA2[,c("Sample_Barcode", "HLA_ClassI")] %>%
  # Split the HLA_ClassI column into separate rows for each allele
  separate_rows(HLA_ClassI, sep = "\\|") %>%
  # Mark presence of each allele with 1
  mutate(value = 1) %>%
  # Pivot to create a wide matrix: rows = alleles, columns = Sample_Barcode
  pivot_wider(names_from = Sample_Barcode, values_from = value,
              values_fill = list(value = 0)) %>%
  # Optionally sort by allele name
  arrange(HLA_ClassI)

dim(hla_I_matrix)
hla_I_matrix[1:2,1:4]

names(HLA2)[names(HLA2) == "HLA-ClassII"] = "HLA_ClassII"
hla_II_matrix <- HLA2[,c("Sample_Barcode", "HLA_ClassII")] %>%
  separate_rows(HLA_ClassII, sep = "\\|") %>%
  mutate(value = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Sample_Barcode, values_from = value,
              values_fill = list(value = 0)) %>%
  arrange(HLA_ClassII)

dim(hla_II_matrix)
hla_II_matrix[1:2,1:4]

hla1_ex = hla_I_matrix$HLA_ClassI[which(hla_I_matrix$`TCGA-DD-AAVP` > 0)]
hla2_ex = hla_II_matrix$HLA_ClassII[which(hla_II_matrix$`TCGA-DD-AAVP` > 0)]

hla1_ex
hla2_ex

HLA2[HLA2$Sample_Barcode == "TCGA-DD-AAVP",]
```

```{r fig.width = 5, fig.height = 3}
df2 <- as.data.frame(df)

# 1) Define the 4 groups by thresholds
df2 <- df2 %>%
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(
      nTCRA >= 30 & nTCRB >= 10 ~ "G4: TCRA≥30 & TCRB≥10",
      nTCRA >= 30 & nTCRB <  10 ~ "G3: TCRA≥30 & TCRB<10",
      nTCRA <  30 & nTCRB >= 10 ~ "G2: TCRA<30 & TCRB≥10",
      TRUE                      ~ "G1: TCRA<30 & TCRB<10"
    )
  )

# 2) Collapse Variant_Classification into 4 categories
df2 <- df2 %>%
  mutate(Category = case_when(
    Variant_Classification == "Frame_Shift_Del"   ~ "Frame Shift Del",
    Variant_Classification == "Missense_Mutation" ~ "Missense Mut.",
    Variant_Classification == "Nonsense_Mutation" ~ "Nonsense Mut.",
    TRUE                                          ~ "Other"
  ))

# Set desired factor orders
df2$Category <- factor(df2$Category,
                       levels = c("Frame Shift Del","Missense Mut.",
                                  "Nonsense Mut.","Other"))
df2$Group <- factor(df2$Group,
                    levels = c("G1: TCRA<30 & TCRB<10",
                               "G2: TCRA<30 & TCRB≥10",
                               "G3: TCRA≥30 & TCRB<10",
                               "G4: TCRA≥30 & TCRB≥10"))

table(df2$Group, df2$Category)

# 3) Relative frequencies within each Group
rel_freq <- df2 %>%
  count(Group, Category, name = "n") %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  mutate(freq = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  complete(Group, Category, fill = list(n = 0, freq = 0))  

# 4) Grouped barplot (four x-groups = categories; 4 bars within each = Groups)
ggplot(rel_freq, aes(x = Category, y = freq, fill = Group)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "G1: TCRA<30 & TCRB<10"   = "grey70", # orange
      "G2: TCRA<30 & TCRB≥10"   = "#56B4E9", # sky blue
      "G3: TCRA≥30 & TCRB<10"   = "#009E73", # bluish green
      "G4: TCRA≥30 & TCRB≥10"   = "#D55E00"  # vermilion
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,   # remove x-axis title
    y = "Relative frequency"
  ) + 
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

```

## Examine the distance across these TCRs

```{r fig.width = 4, fig.height = 3}
source("../tcr_cluster_function/_tcr_dist.R")

compute_tcrdist_matrix <- function(chains, 
                                   dist_fun = TcrDistCalculator, 
                                   use_unique_names = TRUE) {
  if (!is.character(chains)) stop("`chains` must be a character vector.")
  n <- length(chains)
  M <- matrix(0, nrow = n, ncol = n)

  # set dimnames (avoid duplicates if desired)
  rn <- if (use_unique_names) make.unique(chains) else chains
  dimnames(M) <- list(rn, rn)

  if (n <= 1) return(M)

  for (i in seq_len(n - 1)) {
    for (j in (i + 1):n) {
      d <- dist_fun(chains[i], chains[j])
      M[i, j] <- d
      M[j, i] <- d
    }
  }
  M
}


TCRA_all = TCRB_all = NULL

dist_A_within = dist_B_within = list()

for(mut1 in mut2check){
  pred1 = TCR_pred[[mut1]]
  TCRA_all = c(TCRA_all, pred1$TCRA)
  TCRB_all = c(TCRB_all, pred1$TCRB)
  
  D_alpha <- compute_tcrdist_matrix(pred1$TCRA)
  D_beta  <- compute_tcrdist_matrix(pred1$TCRB)

  dist_A_within[[mut1]] = c(D_alpha[upper.tri(D_alpha)])
  dist_B_within[[mut1]] = c(D_beta[upper.tri(D_beta)])
}

length(TCRA_all)
length(TCRB_all)

set.seed(101)
TCRA_all = sample(TCRA_all, 2000)
TCRB_all = sample(TCRB_all, 2000)
length(TCRA_all)
length(TCRB_all)

fA = paste0(result_dir, "/step8_tcr_A_dist.tsv")
fB = paste0(result_dir, "/step8_tcr_B_dist.tsv")

dist_A_all = compute_tcrdist_matrix(TCRA_all)
dist_B_all = compute_tcrdist_matrix(TCRB_all)

dist_A_all = dist_A_all[upper.tri(dist_A_all)]
dist_B_all = dist_B_all[upper.tri(dist_B_all)]

dist_A_within_10 = sapply(dist_A_within, quantile, probs = 0.10)
dist_B_within_10 = sapply(dist_B_within, quantile, probs = 0.10)

dist_A_within_q1 = sapply(dist_A_within, quantile, probs = 0.25)
dist_B_within_q1 = sapply(dist_B_within, quantile, probs = 0.25)

dist_A_within_med = sapply(dist_A_within, median)
dist_B_within_med = sapply(dist_B_within, median)

names(dist_A_within_10) = gsub(".10%", "", names(dist_A_within_10), fixed = TRUE)
names(dist_B_within_10) = gsub(".10%", "", names(dist_B_within_10), fixed = TRUE)

names(dist_A_within_q1) = gsub(".25%", "", names(dist_A_within_q1), fixed = TRUE)
names(dist_B_within_q1) = gsub(".25%", "", names(dist_B_within_q1), fixed = TRUE)

stopifnot(all(names(dist_A_within_q1) == names(dist_A_within_med)))
stopifnot(all(names(dist_A_within_q1) == names(dist_A_within_10)))

stopifnot(all(names(dist_B_within_q1) == names(dist_B_within_med)))
stopifnot(all(names(dist_B_within_q1) == names(dist_B_within_10)))

dist_A_df = data.table(mut=names(dist_A_within_q1), 
                       dec = dist_A_within_10, 
                       q1  = dist_A_within_q1, 
                       med = dist_A_within_med)
dist_A_df = dist_A_df[order(q1),]


dist_B_df = data.table(mut=names(dist_B_within_q1), 
                       dec = dist_B_within_10, 
                       q1  = dist_B_within_q1, 
                       med = dist_B_within_med)

dist_B_df = dist_B_df[order(q1),]

fwrite(dist_A_df, paste0(result_dir, "/step8_tcr_A_dist.tsv"), sep="\t")
fwrite(dist_B_df, paste0(result_dir, "/step8_tcr_B_dist.tsv"), sep="\t")

dist_A_df[1:5,]
dist_A_df[order(dec),][1:5,]
```

## Check for HLA I alleles and TCR overlap

```{r}

get_pvals <- function(X, y){
  apply(X, 1, function(row) {
    # make 2x2 contingency table
    tab <- table(row, y)
    # run Fisher's exact test
    if (all(dim(tab) == c(2,2))) {
      f1 = fisher.test(tab, alternative = "greater")
      res = c(pval = f1$p.value, odds_ratio = f1$estimate)
    } else {
      res = c(pval = NA, odds_ratio = NA)
    }
    res
  })
}

pval_HLA_I = pval_HLA_II = list()
or_HLA_I = or_HLA_II = list()

for(mut1 in mut2check){
  pred1 = TCR_pred[[mut1]]

  stopifnot(all(pred1$TCRB %in% rownames(TCR_mat)))
  
  TCR_mat_sub = TCR_mat[match(pred1$TCRB, rownames(TCR_mat)),]
  sumTCR = colSums(TCR_mat_sub)
  anyTCR = as.numeric(sumTCR > 0)
  res_I  = get_pvals(hla_I_matrix, anyTCR)
  res_II = get_pvals(hla_II_matrix, anyTCR)
  
  pval_HLA_I[[mut1]]  = res_I[1,]
  pval_HLA_II[[mut1]] = res_II[1,]
  
  or_HLA_I[[mut1]]  = res_I[2,]
  or_HLA_II[[mut1]] = res_II[2,]
}

stopifnot(all(sapply(pval_HLA_I, length) == nrow(hla_I_matrix)))
stopifnot(all(sapply(pval_HLA_II, length) == nrow(hla_II_matrix)))


p_hla_I <- do.call(cbind, pval_HLA_I)
dim(p_hla_I)
p_hla_I[1:2, 1:5]

p_hla_II <- do.call(cbind, pval_HLA_II)
dim(p_hla_II)
p_hla_II[1:2, 1:5]

or_hla_I <- do.call(cbind, or_HLA_I)
dim(or_hla_I)
or_hla_I[1:2, 1:5]

or_hla_II <- do.call(cbind, or_HLA_II)
dim(or_hla_II)
or_hla_II[1:2, 1:5]

enriched_I = apply(p_hla_I, 2, function(v){sum(v < 0.05/nrow(p_hla_I))})
enriched_II = apply(p_hla_II, 2, function(v){sum(v < 0.05/nrow(p_hla_II))})

table(enriched_I > 0)
table(enriched_II > 0)


write.table(p_hla_I, paste0(result_dir, "/step8_TCR_HLA_I_overlap_pval.tsv"), 
            sep = "\t", row.names = TRUE)

write.table(p_hla_II, paste0(result_dir, "/step8_TCR_HLA_II_overlap_pval.tsv"), 
            sep = "\t", row.names = TRUE)
```

## Draw a heatmap for HLA_I overlap

```{r fig.height = 10, fig.width = 5}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

thr = 0.05/nrow(p_hla_I)
row_keep <- rowSums(p_hla_I < thr & or_hla_I > 1, na.rm = TRUE) >= 1
col_keep <- colSums(p_hla_I < thr & or_hla_I > 1, na.rm = TRUE) >= 1

p_sub <- p_hla_I[row_keep, col_keep, drop = FALSE]
or_sub <- or_hla_I[row_keep, col_keep, drop = FALSE]

if (nrow(p_sub) == 0 || ncol(p_sub) == 0) {
  stop("No rows/columns pass the threshold; nothing to plot.")
}

bin <- p_sub < thr

# Row (HLA) order
if (nrow(bin) > 1) {
  row_ord <- hclust(dist(bin, method = "binary"))$order
} else row_ord <- seq_len(nrow(bin))

# Column (Mutation) order
if (ncol(bin) > 1) {
  col_ord <- hclust(dist(t(bin), method = "binary"))$order
} else col_ord <- seq_len(ncol(bin))

# Reorder matrix
p_ord <- p_sub[row_ord, col_ord, drop = FALSE]
or_ord <- or_sub[row_ord, col_ord, drop = FALSE]


# Long format for p-values
df_p <- as.data.frame(t(p_ord)) |>
  mutate(Mutation = colnames(p_ord)) |>
  pivot_longer(-Mutation, names_to = "HLA", values_to = "p")

# Long format for OR
df_or <- as.data.frame(t(or_ord)) |>
  mutate(Mutation = colnames(or_ord)) |>
  pivot_longer(-Mutation, names_to = "HLA", values_to = "or")

# Merge p + OR
df_long <- left_join(df_p, df_or, by = c("Mutation","HLA")) |>
  mutate(
    # truncate p at 1e-15 and apply threshold
    logp = ifelse(p < thr, -log10(pmax(p, 1e-15)), NA_real_),
    Mutation = factor(Mutation, levels = colnames(p_ord)),
    HLA      = factor(HLA,      levels = rownames(p_ord))
  )

# Plot with color for -log10(p), size for odds ratio
ggplot(df_long, aes(x = HLA, y = Mutation)) +
  geom_point(
    data = subset(df_long, !is.na(logp)),
    aes(size = or, fill = logp),
    shape = 21, color = "grey30"
  ) +
  # guiding lines
  geom_vline(xintercept = seq(0.5, length(unique(df_long$HLA)) + 0.5, 1),
             color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = seq(0.5, length(unique(df_long$Mutation)) + 0.5, 1),
             color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_size(range = c(1, 3), name = "Odds ratio") +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c("lightblue", "orange", "red"),
    na.value = "white",
    limits = c(-log10(thr), 15),
    oob = scales::squish,
    name = expression(-log[10](p))
  ) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)
```

## Check a few examples for HLA-I

```{r fig.height = 7, fig.width = 4.5}
mut1 = "TP53:R273L"
sort(p_hla_I[,mut1])[1:5]
sort(or_hla_I[,mut1], decreasing = TRUE)[1:5]

anyTCR = as.numeric(sumTCR > 0)

stopifnot(all(names(TCR_mat_sub) == names(hla_II_matrix)))

for(hla_name in hla_names){
  HLA_v = unlist(hla_I_matrix[hla_name,])
  table(anyTCR, HLA_v)
  f1 = fisher.test(table(anyTCR, HLA_v), alternative = "greater")
  
  print(hla_name)

  print(f1$estimate)
  cq1 = chisq.test(table(anyTCR, HLA_v))
  print(cq1$expected)
  print(cq1$observed)

  cat("\n")

}
```
